Covers Annapolis region including Severn River and adjacent part of Chesapeake Bay. Relief shown by hachures. Depths shown by shading and soundings. "Buoys corrected to 1874." Facsimile. Includes text, notes in margins, statistical data, and 4 coastal panoramas. Publisher's no.: BiC-29. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.
